title: FX run removal (fx-run-removal-v1)
description: `grida-fx runs remove --json`: what a removal did, or would do without --yes (spec/store.md §8, "Removing a run"). An error document means nothing was removed.

applied.description: false for a preview (no --yes) and for an error: nothing was removed.

skipped.description: How many runs the filters matched but passed over, by reason.

freed_bytes.description: Bytes of files whose every link was inside the removed folders.

cache_bytes.description: Bytes of files still linked from elsewhere (the store, other runs); removing the runs does not free them.

folder.description: The run folder, relative to the working directory of the command (or absolute when it shares no root with it).

workflow.description: The recorded workflow id, or the one its position gives; null when neither is known.

source.description: The recorded workflow source (`plan.json` `workflow.file`); null for a folder without a plan.

name.description: The run's name: recorded, or given by a named position.

placement.description: allocated: `<runs>/<id>/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<n>`; named: `<runs>/<id>/named-<digest>/<NAME>-<digest>`; explicit: elsewhere in the runs tree; external: outside it, known from the run index or the catalog (spec/store.md §9).

state.description: As inspect reads the log, with inspect's failed split into incomplete (ok false, incomplete true) and failed; empty: no plan.json at a run's position; removing: a removal's tombstone; missing: an external folder that is gone. Recorded unfinished is not evidence that a process is alive.

created_at.description: The first run_started's creation time (RFC 3339); null for a folder without a plan.

charged_usd.description: The charge in USD the last run_finished or run_cancelled records; null before the run ended.

outcome.description: would_*: a preview. forgotten: a missing external folder's run index and catalog entries removed. refused: nothing of this run was removed. partial: the run is gone as a run, but its tombstone could not be removed; runs remove finishes it.

code.description: active: an invocation holds its run.lock. holds_pick: the last run holding a pick, or one whose takes file cannot be read. changed: it no longer holds what was selected, or a run started inside it. not_removable: it could not be locked or renamed (nothing changed). io: its tombstone could not be removed.
